title: Orthonormal families are linearly independent
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with a probability mass function $\pi$, and let $\{v_a:a\in\iota\}$ be a finite family of real-valued functions on $\Omega$. If $\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)v_a(x)v_b(x)$ equals $1$ when $a=b$ and $0$ otherwise for every $a,b\in\iota$, then the family is linearly independent over $\mathbb{R}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
The functions are pairwise orthonormal under the weighted sum defined by $\pi$
